title: Is Mount Rushmore Unfinished?
content: The original design for Mount Rushmore showed far more of the figures, as suggested by this preliminary maquette.I have digitally superimposed the actual carvings of the faces over the maquette. Susan B. Anthony was supposed to be included, too.But by 1941, federal funding was cut back, and the sculptor, Danish-AmericanGutzon Borglum, died of a heart attack while the work was still being carved.This video has aerial shots that show more of the setting.(Link to video) Video by Smithsonian.Read more about the design history of the monument at Time.com.
